name: From The Wreckage....
summary: Gar'Thok sends Horde scouts to the wrecks off the Scuttle Coast for Gnomish Tools. The Horde hopes to study Alliance engineering and turn its advantage to their own use.

sections.title: Echoes of the Fleet
sections.body: Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore brought Kul Tiras's fleet to Kalimdor, where its ships crowded the shore near Tiragarde Keep. After his defeat, broken hulls sank along the Scuttle Coast. Kul Tiran soldiers who survived fortify the keep, while the fleet's wreckage lies scattered on the shoals beneath the tide.

sections.title: Gnomish Contraptions
sections.body: The Horde knows Alliance ingenuity can give its enemies an edge over orcish strength, iron, and blood. Gnomish technicians sailed with the expeditionary fleet and equipped its ships with complex machinery and precise tools. Gar'Thok wants those tools recovered from the wrecks so the Horde can learn how they work.

sections.title: Destined for Orgrimmar
sections.body: Gar'Thok sends the salvaged tools by caravan from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Horde craftspeople and tacticians hope to study the gnomish instruments and better counter Alliance devices in future conflicts, while strengthening their own industries.

faq.q: Why is the Horde salvaging tools from these wrecks?
faq.answer: The Horde wants to understand the Alliance's advanced technology. Gnomes make intricate machinery for human forces, and studying their tools may show Horde tacticians how to counter Alliance devices and adapt useful designs for their own craftspeople.

faq.q: Whose ships are wrecked off the Scuttle Coast?
faq.answer: The wrecked ships belonged to Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's Kul Tiras fleet. After landing in Durotar to fight Thrall's newly founded nation, several were destroyed along the coast just east of Tiragarde Keep.

faq.q: Where do the recovered tools go after Razor Hill?
faq.answer: Gar'Thok sends the recovered Gnomish Tools by caravan from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Engineers and craftspeople there can study them to strengthen the capital's defenses and industry.

faq.q: Why are gnomish tools found on human warships?
faq.answer: Gnomes are close allies of the humans in the Grand Alliance. They often bring mechanical expertise, siege gear, and precision tools to keep human warships working.
The Scuttle Coast is Durotar's eastern shore, running past Tiragarde Keep. Its shallow waters hold half-submerged and sunken ships left after the battles against Proudmoore's expedition.

faq.q: How does this task relate to the threat at Tiragarde Keep?
faq.answer: After the assault on Tiragarde Keep clears out Kul Tiran marines, Gar'Thok takes the chance to claim the remaining Alliance resources. The Horde can profit from the defeat by stripping nearby wrecks before scavengers or the tide take everything.

angles.text: For you as a tinker, the Gnomish Tools show the early clash between Alliance mechanical precision and the Horde's growing craft industries.
As a member of the Horde, you know Gar'Thok sees Alliance metal as both knowledge for defeating future invasions and material for building Durotar.
As a gnome, you leave your mark wherever the Alliance sails. The Horde respects your sophisticated gear enough to send scouts to recover it.
